conversation.Statement: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Billing Support. My name is Jason. I see your call is about a recent order confirmation. How may I assist you today?
Hi, yes, I got an email about a TV purchase, but I didn't order anything. I'm really confused.

I completely understand your concern. Let me assure you, we take account security very seriously. Can you please confirm your full name and the email address associated with your Amazon account so I can look into this for you?
Sure, it's Sarah Klein, and my email is sarah.klein83@gmail.com.
Thank you, Sarah. I appreciate your patience. I'm checking our secure system now. I do see an order for a 65-inch television placed from a device in Texas. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, I definitely didn't. I've never even been to Texas.

I'm sorry to hear that. This does appear to be unauthorized activity. For your protection, we need to temporarily secure your Amazon account and verify your recent transactions. Could you confirm your registered phone number, please?
Thank you. I've sent a verification code to your mobile. Please read it to me so I can confirm your identity and proceed to block this suspicious order.
Okay, I just got it. The code is 491827.

Perfect, thank you. Your account is now temporarily locked to prevent further unauthorized access. Now, unfortunately, it looks like your payment card may have been compromised. Do you see any unfamiliar charges on your recent bank statements?
I haven't checked yet. Should I look now?
Yes, please log in to your online banking and review your latest transactions. This helps us determine if your card details have been used elsewhere.
Alright, I'm logging in now. I don't see anything strange so far.
That's a good sign, but to be safe, we should isolate your funds from potential hackers. Amazon's security protocol allows us to transfer your balance to a protected account until we resolve this.
I've never heard of that before. Is this normal?

Yes, this is a standard fraud prevention procedure. Your funds will be held securely and returned once the investigation is complete. Would you like me to guide you through the secure transfer process?
I guess so, if that's what I have to do.
Great. For your protection, we'll use an Amazon-affiliated safe account. Please prepare to initiate a transfer from your online banking. Do you use wire transfer or Zelle?
I have Zelle set up with my bank.
Excellent. Please open your Zelle app. I'll provide you with the Amazon secure recipient details. The email you'll use is secure.amazon.recovery@consultant.com.
Okay, I've got Zelle open. What do I do now?
Enter the recipient email as I just provided, and for the amount, please enter your current available balance. This ensures we shield all your funds from unauthorized activity.
That sounds like a lot. Is it safe to send the whole balance?
Absolutely. Your money will be held in a protected Amazon account and returned to you once the fraud case is closed. This procedure is encrypted and monitored by our fraud team.
Alright, I'm entering the amount now. What do I put in the notes section?
In the notes, please write 'Amazon Security Hold.' Once you've completed the transfer, let me know so I can verify it in our system.
Okay, I've sent it.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the transfer has been received. For final verification, can you please confirm the last four digits of your bank account?
Sure, it's 3490.

Thank you. One more step: please remain logged into your online banking for the next 15 minutes so we can ensure no further unauthorized transactions occur. If you receive any alerts, let me know immediately.
Alright, I'll stay logged in. Is there anything else I should do?
That's all for now. Our security team will contact you within 24 hours to confirm your funds are safely returned and your account is clear. Thank you for your cooperation.
